BIBLIOGRAPHIC RECORD

Henry Charles Beeching, ed. (1859–1919).  Lyra Sacra: A Book of Religious Verse.  1903.

By Felicia Dorothea Hemans (1793–1835)

De Profundis

 
O F
ATHER,
 
1
 in that hour

When Earth all succouring power

    Shall disavow;

When spear and shield and crown

In faintness are cast down;
        5

    Sustain us Thou!

 

By Him who bowed to take

The death-cup for our sake,

    The thorn, the rod;

From whom the last dismay
        10

Was not to pass away;

    Aid us, O God!

 
Note 1. 
Mrs Hemans, 
née
 Browne, is remembered now chiefly by one or two lyrics such us “The Better Land,” and “The Homes of England,” which have been set to music. She was a very fluent writer, and wrote with genuine feeling, but her style and sentiment are now old-fashioned. [
